crossRefs.note: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds, and…

translations.web: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.
translations.bsb: and since I wanted to understand their charges against him, I brought him down to their Sanhedrin.
translations.kjv: And when I would have known the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him forth into their council:
translations.asv: And desiring to know the cause wherefore they accused him, I brought him down unto their council:
